vocabulary_note: verdict uses the closed T2 vocabulary as a status+diagnosis pair (same shape as the A3/A4/E artefacts); this is the LIVE half of the Phase E2 zero-n0 acceptance (C8 plan B) — the hermetic halves are the discovery_override Tier-A suite (env->plan decision) and the node.rs two-node Tier-B test (assembly converges via an in-process self-hosted stack)
scoping_note: this acceptance proves (once run) that the network converges and serves WITHOUT any n0 service — resilience to the n0 EOL 2026-09-30. It does NOT prove resilience to the death of the operator VPS: zero-n0 CONCENTRATES relay+pkarr+anchor onto operator infrastructure, so it is COMPLEMENTARY to (not a superset of) the S75 survives-VPS-death acceptance, which ran under presets::N0 with n0 alive; neither tests 'operator host dies while in zero-n0 mode'

hermetic_anchors.tier_a_decision_suite: discovery_override::tests (6 tests: returns_none_when_unset_or_disabled, fails_loud_on_unrecognised_gate_value, fails_loud_when_pkarr_relays_missing, fails_loud_when_custom_relays_missing, builds_plan_when_fully_configured, pkarr_url_policy_matches_relay_policy) — the pure env->DiscoveryPlan decision core: parse, https/loopback policy parity, fail-loud coupling with custom relays
hermetic_anchors.tier_b_e2e_assembly: node::tests::zero_n0_two_nodes_converge_via_self_hosted_stack — two endpoints built by the SAME apply_zero_n0_discovery function as production, connected BY ID ONLY through an in-process PUT+GET pkarr relay (raw-tokio fake; iroh's test-utils pkarr server only routes PUT) and an in-process iroh relay (test-utils run_relay_server); proves the assembly really omits n0 (fresh empty MemoryLookup per endpoint, no other lookup wired)

residual_risk: zero-n0 relocates discovery+relay trust and availability from n0 to the SBFB operator: relay operator sees connection metadata (never plaintext), pkarr operator is the resolution authority bounded by Ed25519-signed packets (censor/stale possible, forge impossible); operator-host SPOF and the relay-metadata x anchor-content join are routed to Phase G (THREAT_MODEL §15.x zero-n0 line) together with the widened silent-loss window (self-hosted single host vs the four-region n0 fleet; pkarr death stays warn-only inside iroh, no SBFB health signal)
